narrative_prose: The dense warmth of the hearth presses outward against the chilling draft of the valley floor, the copper kettles glowing a deep umber in the low light. Plumes of spiced steam catch the erratic flickers of the ferrofluid manifold's ambient glow. It is a tight, secure sanctuary of boiling stock and scrubbed metal, anchoring the chaotic sprawl of the settlement. Ryn raps her heavy brass ladle on the butcher block, CONCEALING the vital reagents within the massive copper vat. She steps forward to DEFEND the structural exhaust vent from the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. Carefully, she ensures the iron-wheat starter crock will CONSUME the necessary thermal energy without failing.
